title: Theatre Keeps the Doors Open
transcript: The Benton Theatre will remain open this winter thanks to a campaign by local residents. Earlier this year, rising heating costs put the theatre at risk of closing for three months. More than eight hundred people donated to a public appeal. Part of the money will be used to replace old windows, which should cut heating bills in future. The theatre will thank supporters with a free concert next Friday. Seats can be reserved on its website from Monday morning.

questions.prompt: Why was the theatre in danger of closing?
options: The cost of heating had increased.
questions.answer: The cost of heating had increased.
questions.explanation: 采暖费用上涨使剧院面临暂时关闭。

questions.prompt: How will some of the money be spent?
questions.explanation: 用一部分钱更换旧窗户，希望以后能降低取暖开支。
